title: Dario F NDE 1096
content:
On our way back from Atucha 1 (a nuclear power station), while escorting a five-truck convoy with nuclear waste, at a certain point, a car with two criminals began shooting at us a few blocks away at us. I got out of the truck and started shooting at them as well, killing both. Since I noticed further shooting, I headed off for the other trucks. Right then, bullets hit me, piercing the bullet-proof jacket… One bullet went right beside my heart; another one reached my spine; the third went to my belly and intestines, and the last two hit both legs. In the surgery room, I had my first NDE: I started to float over my body and saw how the surgeons were performing surgery on me. I was right beside one of them and wanted to touch him, but my hand went right through his body. I got scared and suddenly everything blackened out… I then saw a light in the distance and I moved there. I saw a green field with lots of vegetation and a river with a bridge made of the finest gold and jewels with writings in all languages praising God. I crossed the bridge and met my grandmother and the vice governor of the Falklands, Mr. Ramon Barrios, together. I met relatives of mine, who I could not remember, as well. I said to myself 'I’ll stay here'. I clarified that I was a married man and that I had a four-year old daughter. I heard a voice telling me: 'It is not your time; it is not your time'. I turned around and saw Christ. I could not see His face, since He was very bright and shiny but I did recognize His hands, thanks to the punctured wound marks. He told me in a commanding and loving tone, 'You must go back.' I felt two hands on my shoulders and then I returned to my body. 72 hours later, according to my wife, my heart stopped again and I began the same experience: seeing my body from above, I moved right beside my body, which, at this time, was connected to lots of tubes. All of a sudden, an angel appeared wearing combat vestments as a soldier, but white. He was about five meters (16 and a half feet) tall. I asked him, ‘Who are you?’ And he replied, ‘Do you care? I am Mich'l and I have to bring you to another place.’ I felt as though I were being suctioned and blown downwards…I reached a lake of blood and there was rotten burnt flesh. The smell of putrid flesh was unbearable. Holes would open in the earth at every step and horrible worms would come up. I raised my eyes and saw a man bending down and a demon raping him… and the demon was donkey-headed. To the right I saw the anus of a giant that was defecating demons… To the left I saw people dancing… they wanted to stop but the demons did not let them. They noticed me and wanted to attack but Mich'l made the sign of the cross and the demons backed off, blaspheming God, the angel, and myself. Mich'l embraced me and took me out from there. Right beside my body he said, ‘It’s your choice; your last chance: you have seen both Heaven and Hell. Now it is up to you from onwards.’ I returned to my body and recovered.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Christ was 'very bright and shiny'; face not visible; hands recognized by 'punctured wound marks.'
arrival.other_being_detail: An angel in white combat vestments 'as a soldier' about 'five meters (16 and a half feet) tall' identified himself as 'Mich'l.'

environment.environment_other_detail: Bridge 'made of the finest gold and jewels with writings in all languages praising God'; later realm included a 'lake of blood,' 'rotten burnt flesh,' holes opening in the earth with worms.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: First NDE: 'I felt two hands on my shoulders and then I returned to my body.' Second NDE: returned after being told 'It's your choice; your last chance...'
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Mich'l said: 'It’s your choice; your last chance: you have seen both Heaven and Hell. Now it is up to you from onwards.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Shot multiple times while escorting a nuclear-waste convoy; NDE during surgery; second episode '72 hours later' when 'my heart stopped again.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Hellish realm imagery: 'lake of blood,' demons, worms, putrid flesh; angel protection using 'the sign of the cross.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: First episode: OBE in surgery room → darkness → distant light → pastoral realm/bridge → relatives → voice 'not your time' → Christ → return. Second episode: OBE → angel guide → downward suction → hellish realm → message about choice → return.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: OBE and return occurred in both episodes; second experience described as 'the same experience' initially (seeing body from above).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Bridge 'made of the finest gold and jewels with writings in all languages praising God'; angel in 'combat vestments' 5 meters tall; graphic hell imagery including 'anus of a giant that was defecating demons.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'It is not your time; it is not your time'. 'You must go back.' 'Do you care? I am Mich'l and I have to bring you to another place.' 'It’s your choice; your last chance: you have seen both Heaven and Hell. Now it is up to you from onwards.'
